name: sendmock-testcontainers
description: Starts SendMock in Docker from a test and gives its SMTP, HTTP and provider addresses.

scripts.build: bun build src/sendmock-container.ts --outdir dist --target node --format esm --packages external && bunx --package typescript@5.9.3 tsc src/sendmock-container.ts --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist --module nodenext --moduleResolution nodenext --target es2022 --skipLibCheck
